name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: Derived from the ABS mid-quarter month: February is quarter 1, May is 2, August is 3 and November is 4.

name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12
observations: The ABS mid-quarter month, always February, May, August or November.

name: industry_division_code
description: ANZSIC 2006 division letter, from A to S
observations: Not published in the cube: attached from the ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0 division list, asserted to cover every observed label. In employment_industry, where the cube publishes group-level codes, the division is derived from the group code's ANZSIC subdivision (its first two digits), and directly from the letter for the 19 division-level nfd residuals.
original_name: Industry division of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: industry_division
description: ANZSIC 2006 division of the main job
observations: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0, carried by ABS across the whole history of the cube. A dedicated ANZSIC directory does not exist yet in br_bd_diretorios_au and is future work.
original_name: Industry division of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0
